propositions: BindingRepository must own live, retired, rotation, and alert file persistence with byte-identical round-trip serialization and exact sorted/indented/trailing-newline preservation, performing no eager write on construction.

Unconditional save must attempt rotation persistence before live replacement, retaining inline last_get_pass as a floor when rotation sidecar write fails, and recovering to sidecar convergence on the next successful save.

Corrupt live state must raise ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired state must fail open, return empty, preserve the file, and emit a best-effort deduplicated alert that swallows its own failure.

Rotation, retired, and live persistence failures must follow precise ordered failure semantics: rotation failure leaves sidecar old and live new without raising; retired/live failure leaves those files old and raises; live failure after successful retired write retains the retired result.
All 8 acceptance criteria verified by 27 green unit tests including fault injection at tempfile/write/replace boundaries and two-save convergence recovery after simulated sidecar write failure.
Facade cutover, lifecycle extraction, tickets publication, recovery cutover, and dirty/write-elision optimization remain out of scope.
